text.description_html:
Acorn RH5BP, 7" Full Mortis Butt Hinge Dummy Plate

Easy to install, the Rough Iron Dummy Hinge Plate is for light doors or small doors. It can be used in either interior or exterior applications. This is used with Acorn's RH6BP L Plate. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered iron.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories for your home. From some of New England's finest Blacksmiths.

Specifications of the 7" Hinge Dummy Hinge Plate:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Height 7"
  • For use with full mortise butt hinges 3-1/2" x 3-1/2" up to 4" x 4".
  • Finished on both sides so they are reversible.

Sold individually. Item includes one plate.
